This video showcases my approach to treating clients with repetitive strain injuries through various massage therapies. With over 10 years of experience at Victoria Park Sports Massage Clinic, where I also manage operations, I am deeply passionate about my work and dedicated to helping people achieve better health and well-being. Australia is a beautiful country that I’m grateful to call home, and I love sharing my knowledge to support others on their wellness journey. Wishing you all health, happiness, and the very best!
